q: Which animal hears the highest frequencies?
Suggest why elephants hear very low sounds well.
They communicate with low-frequency rumbles that travel far through air and ground.
Older adults often cannot hear above 12 000 Hz. Suggest why, and why shops may use a 17 000 Hz sound to deter teenagers.
Hair cells for high frequencies are damaged with age and noise; teenagers can still hear 17 000 Hz but adults cannot.
